name: Yun Shi Gu
source:
The owner of an illegal call girl operation in Kabukicho. When he was young, he was the leader of a group of hot-blooded Shanghainese militants.

Now he has been reduced to scraping together a living under the watchful eyes of the yakuza and the police, yet this does nothing to deter him from sticking it out in Kabukicho. 

[From Shiravune, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
